run_record_defect.class: suspected plugin-level defect in scripts/write-provenance.mjs, NOT a one-off in this run
run_record_defect.title: Multi-round edits overwrite the per-file backup slot and re-stamp existed_before, destroying the pre-run state for new files
run_record_defect.what: provenance.json records packages/web/src/grid/components/EventJoinIcon.tsx as existed_before:true with a non-null sha_before, for a file that did not exist before this run. The stored backup is a mid-run intermediate, not the pre-run state.
run_record_defect.cause: One file was written by three packets (tp_004_event_join_icon, rp_001_join_icon_refine, rp_003_sec_remediation). Each --before call wrote to the same per-file backup slot and re-stamped existed_before from the moment of that call, so rounds 2 and 3 destroyed round 1's pre-run observation. Any file touched by more than one packet in a run is affected; the damage is only unrecoverable when the file is untracked in git.

evidence.conclusion: The backup is the post-senior-review / pre-security-remediation intermediate.

run_record_defect.impact: /mmo:revert would restore EventJoinIcon.tsx to a mid-run intermediate version instead of removing it, silently leaving a file the pre-run tree never had. The other 8 changed files are tracked in git and revert correctly from git_head_before = 2d81253a.
run_record_defect.manual_remedy: On revert, packages/web/src/grid/components/EventJoinIcon.tsx must be DELETED, never restored from backups/.
run_record_defect.plugin_fix_hint: Make --before idempotent per (run_id, path): if a row for the path already exists, do not overwrite its existed_before/sha_before and do not overwrite its backup slot. The first observation in a run is the only one that describes the pre-run state.
